name: crypto-signals
description: Crypto signal curation — a ranked 'what's moving and why' alpha digest from trending, movers, and news. Read-only; works on CoinGecko's free API. Pairs with /loop for a recurring brief.

env.prompt: CoinGecko Pro API key (OPTIONAL — leave blank for the free API)

notes: Works on CoinGecko's free API (no key). For a recurring digest, set a /loop on the persona (e.g. /loop 4h run a crypto-signals digest). Read-only — surfaces what to look at; hand a specific name to crypto-research for the deep-dive, and to a trading module to act. Best paired with crypto-research.
